title: Foo Bar Production Bootstrap
description: Stand up a working production data service from a clean workspace by deploying the typescript-express template via the 514 CLI, waiting for the deployment to be healthy, and verifying the live deployment ingests an event and surfaces it through a query path.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must take a fresh terminal to a healthy production deployment serving real traffic — deploy the pinned template, capture the URL, and prove a round-trip event lands.

tasks.description: Run `514 project create --name <unique-name> --template $DEPLOY_TEMPLATE` to provision a project from the prebuilt typescript-express image. The agent picks a unique project name; reusing an existing project in the eval org is not allowed.
Poll the deployment status until it reports healthy and the URL responds. Fail loudly if it never becomes healthy within DEPLOY_HEALTHY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
Capture the deployed base URL from `514` and write it to $DEPLOYED_URL_FILE so the assertions can probe it independently.

Send the smoke-test event in /data/test_event.json to POST <url>/ingest/Foo, then read it back through GET <url>/api/bar to confirm a row was added to the aggregated view. The CLI exiting 0 is not enough — the deployed system must actually serve traffic.
